name: token-max
description: In-app, report-only token audit for Codex and Claude

interface.shortDescription: Find evidence-backed token improvements without code changes.
interface.longDescription: Run an audit inside your chat using available project tools. No terminal setup or Python dependency for the default review; optional local collectors support Codex measurements.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $token-audit to report where this session and project could use fewer tokens without changing code.
